objective: C05: replace the nine-retained quotient search by the exact published nine-point theorem and a fully explicit common-cycle P3 gluing construction, with bounded adversarial tests.

atomic_claims.text: For any finite simple cubic frame and a retained set of size divisible by three on one supplied simple cycle, the Petersen-brick expansion has a P3-factor for arbitrary terminal attachment bijections.

The published nine-point cyclability theorem applied to a 3-connected cubic frame supplies that cycle when exactly nine vertices are retained, eliminating the need for the preceding nine-retained quotient enumeration.

The local construction produced checked P3-factors in 10890 supplied-cycle cases, covered all seven needed local signatures, and rejected four specified invalid-input classes. This is not a test of universal cyclability.
Consecutive vertex triples on each cycle of a supplied divisible-cycle 2-factor give a P3-factor; extra graph edges are unselected, not required to be absent.

assumptions: Finite simple graphs; cubic means every vertex has degree three; 3-connected means vertex connectivity at least three.
P3 is a selected two-edge path on three distinct vertices, not necessarily induced.
Petersen-minus-vertex bricks have the explicitly specified edges and port bijections.
Allowed axioms remain finite-graph-basic and finite-combinatorics; the published cyclability theorem is an external proof dependency, not a newly admitted axiom.
risks: The nine-point publisher abstract and metadata were checked, but its full proof was not audited.
The finite code checks explicit supplied cycles, not the universal source theorem or all cubic frames.
Six deterministic heterogeneous port assignments per retained subset were tested; arbitrary assignments are covered by the local proof, not global enumeration.
The twelve-point publisher abstract gives a conditional characterization, not an unconditional extension; its actual condition remains unread.
Candidate proof, local computation, source attribution and transport success do not create EvidenceLinks or close the root.
